title: Kohler secretly records the OSI interview

tellings.quote: and what Coler did as they were going into the recording room, he told the technician, "Record this."

plain: In 1950 a man named George Kohler was questioned by the Air Force Office of Special Investigations at a Denver radio station, KMYR, and as they walked into the recording room he told the technician, "Record this." The researcher Scott Ramsey tells this, crediting the recording itself, in which men named Hansen and Unger also figure. If the recording exists as he describes, it would preserve exactly what investigators asked Kohler about a crash story at the time.
